messages:
amanda: Quick sync — need to pick scope for our Console observability milestone. Proposing: 1) incident timeline widget (lite), 2) sample trace embed (top-level spans + link), 3) cost-per-route table, 4) error-slice explorer (basic). Want tradeoffs before planning. TL;DR: prioritize developer signal vs instrumentation complexity. Thoughts?

raj: Sounds good. Q on sample trace: do we need full flamegraph or just top-level spans? Full flamegraphs are heavy for the console.

noah: Top-level spans + link to trace in tracing UI. Embed can be static JSON + small CSS to keep perf low.

sophia: UX note — incident timeline should have compact and expanded modes. If it's a horizontal band on alert details it stays non-invasive.

maria: +1 on cost-per-route. Customers (enterprise) have been asking for per-endpoint cost breakdowns. Need percent-of-cost and top offenders.

amanda: @maria noted customer asks. Ok we treat cost-per-route as MVP but aggregated only (no per-request replay).

raj: Implementation notes: backend needs a nightly aggregation job; rough estimate 2 sprints. trace embed touches runtime for kv-cache metadata.

raj: Example aggregation query we'll reuse:
```
SELECT route, sum(cost) as total_cost, count(*) as calls
FROM inference_billing
WHERE org_id = $ORG
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

noah: Also need to ensure auth gating for private deployments — no prompt or sensitive input should be surfaced in embeds. PMs confirm policy.

amanda: Confirmed. Tenant isolation and scrub sensitive fields before any UI surface. Add to checklist.

sophia: I'll drop mockups by EOD Monday (compact timeline + trace card + cost table).

devex-bot: amanda created doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/console/obs/mvp-scope-draft

raj: Rollout acceptance criteria proposal: latency impact <5% p95 for console pages, infra cost delta <10%, validation via 3 customer signoffs + internal QA.

maria: I can own 2 customer signoffs (AcmeCorp, FinBeta) and coordinate beta access.

amanda: Agreement for scope: lite timeline, trace embed (top-level + link), cost-per-route aggregated (top5), error-slice explorer (filter by tag/label). Out of scope: full flamegraphs, live trace streaming, ML anomaly detection.

noah: I'll file an RFC for the trace API changes and link the job plan.

amanda: Thanks all. I'll break this into tickets and update the public roadmap. If no objections by Friday, lock scope and move to sprint planning. :calendar:
